/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'){
    const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,decagrammatonReferenceStrokes());
    const valid=accuracy>=.72;return {valid,skillId:'decagrammaton-ultimate',label:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw a square overlaid with a diamond.'};
  }
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  // CLIP can confuse overlapping frames with Umbrella's enclosing circle. Local geometry wins.
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return {valid:false,reason:'This is a linked-frame pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Normalize X/Y independently so canvas size and squashed proportions do not affect casting. */
export function normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (!(width > 0) || !(height > 0)) return [];
  return strokes.map(stroke => stroke.map(point => ({
    x: (point.x - bounds.left) / width * 200,
    y: (point.y - bounds.top) / height * 200
  })));
}

/** Measure the drawing alone, excluding the game, HUD, dimmer and decorative stroke glow. */
export function drawingBounds(strokes) {
  const points = strokes.flat();
  if (!points.length) return null;
  return points.reduce((bounds, point) => ({ left: Math.min(bounds.left, point.x),
    top: Math.min(bounds.top, point.y), right: Math.max(bounds.right, point.x),
    bottom: Math.max(bounds.bottom, point.y) }),
    { left: Infinity, top: Infinity, right: -Infinity, bottom: -Infinity });
}

/** Normalize a cropped sketch into a square black-on-white image for QuickDraw. */
export function drawingModelImage(strokes, createCanvas = () => document.createElement('canvas')) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const canvas = createCanvas(), size = skillCastSettings.modelInputSize;
  canvas.width = canvas.height = size;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);
  const usable = size - skillCastSettings.modelPadding * 2;
  const scale = usable / Math.max(1, bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top);
  const centerX = (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2, centerY = (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2;
  context.strokeStyle = '#000'; context.lineWidth = skillCastSettings.modelLineWidth;
  context.lineCap = context.lineJoin = 'round';
  for (const stroke of strokes) {
    if (stroke.length < 2) continue;
    context.beginPath();
    stroke.forEach((point, index) => {
      const x = size / 2 + (point.x - centerX) * scale, y = size / 2 + (point.y - centerY) * scale;
      if (index) context.lineTo(x, y); else context.moveTo(x, y);
    });
    context.stroke();
  }
  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
}

/** Render the visible Schale-style cyan/blue/lilac line, retaining separate pen strokes. */
export function drawSkillStrokes(context, strokes, width, height) {
  context.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
  const gradient = context.createLinearGradient(0, height, width, 0);
  gradient.addColorStop(0, '#b7fbff'); gradient.addColorStop(0.35, '#45dcff');
  gradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#408dff'); gradient.addColorStop(1, '#d6acff');
  context.save();
  context.strokeStyle = gradient; context.lineWidth = skillCastSettings.lineWidth;
  context.lineCap = context.lineJoin = 'round'; context.shadowColor = '#62dfff'; context.shadowBlur = 9;
  for (const stroke of strokes) {
    if (!stroke.length) continue;
    context.beginPath();
    stroke.forEach((point, index) => index ? context.lineTo(point.x, point.y) : context.moveTo(point.x, point.y));
    context.stroke();
  }
  context.restore();
}

/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}


/** Three crown spikes with open underside; a diamond sits above the crown. */
export function supernovaReferenceStrokes() {
  const path = points => points.map(([x,y]) => ({x,y}));
  return [path([[45,165],[35,110],[67.5,142],[100,110],[132.5,142],[165,110],[155,165]]),
    path([[100,25],[126,60],[100,95],[74,60],[100,25]])];
}

/** Geometric whole-symbol matching plus isolated QuickDraw assistance, with offline fallback. */
export async function recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent) {
  const normalized = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(normalized);
  if (!bounds) return {valid:false,reason:'Draw the Supernova pattern.'};
  const width = bounds.right-bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom-bounds.top;
  const split = bounds.top + height*.53;
  const upper = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y<split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const lower = normalized.map(stroke=>stroke.filter(p=>p.y>=split)).filter(s=>s.length);
  const diamondBounds=drawingBounds(upper), crownBounds=drawingBounds(lower);
  // The narrow diamond sits above the wider crown; reject enclosing circles/partial symbols.

import { drawingBounds, normalizeSkillStrokes } from './skill-drawing.js';
import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Canonical pattern matching the EX Skills reference diagram. */
export function planaReferenceStrokes() {
  return [Array.from({ length: 97 }, (_, i) => ({
    x: 100 + 86 * Math.cos(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2),
    y: 100 + 86 * Math.sin(i / 96 * Math.PI * 2)
  })), [{ x: 100, y: 94 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }],
  [{ x: 76, y: 67 }, { x: 100, y: 43 }, { x: 124, y: 67 }],
  [{ x: 75, y: 119 }, { x: 125, y: 160 }],
  [{ x: 125, y: 119 }, { x: 75, y: 160 }]];
}

/** Uniformly sample ink length, ignoring pen speed, stroke order and direction. */
function normalizedInk(strokes) {
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return [];
  const size = Math.max(bounds.right - bounds.left, bounds.bottom - bounds.top, 1);
  const points = [];
  for (const stroke of strokes) for (let i = 1; i < stroke.length; i++) {
    const a = stroke[i - 1], b = stroke[i];
    const count = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y) / size * 180));
    for (let j = 0; j <= count; j++) points.push({
      x: (a.x + (b.x - a.x) * j / count - (bounds.left + bounds.right) / 2) / size,
      y: (a.y + (b.y - a.y) * j / count - (bounds.top + bounds.bottom) / 2) / size
    });
  }
  // Bound comparison work even for very long mouse strokes.
  const unique = [...new Map(points.map(p => [
    `${Math.round(p.x * 10000)},${Math.round(p.y * 10000)}`, p
  ])).values()].sort((a, b) => Math.round(a.x * 10000) - Math.round(b.x * 10000) ||
    Math.round(a.y * 10000) - Math.round(b.y * 10000));
  return unique.filter((_, i) => i % Math.max(1, Math.ceil(unique.length / 320)) === 0);
}

/** Symmetric ink distance rewards the entire reference, including missing/extra marks. */
export function drawingAccuracy(strokes, referenceStrokes = planaReferenceStrokes()) {
  const actual = normalizedInk(strokes), reference = normalizedInk(referenceStrokes);
  if (!actual.length) return 0;
  const nearestMean = (from, to) => from.reduce((total, p) => total +
    Math.min(...to.map(q => Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y))), 0) / from.length;
  const error = (nearestMean(actual, reference) + nearestMean(reference, actual)) / 2;
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - error / skillCastSettings.accuracyDistanceTolerance));
}

/** Map successful reference accuracy to minimum/typical/perfect damage anchors. */
export function skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy) {
  const s = skillCastSettings;
  const value = Number.isFinite(accuracy) ? accuracy : s.accuracyAverage;
  const low = value <= s.accuracyAverage;
  const start = low ? s.accuracyMinimum : s.accuracyAverage;
  const end = low ? s.accuracyAverage : s.accuracyPerfect;
  const from = low ? s.damageMinimum : s.damageAverage;

/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}

/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return skills.find(w=>['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(w.id)&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'?decagrammatonReferenceStrokes():['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?princessKeyReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;
}

import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { molotovSettings, molotovLevelStats, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { molotovAnimationReady, drawMolotovNapalm } from './molotov-animation.js';

/** Explicit fallback odds: 30% close, 60% middle, 10% far; randomized within each band. */
export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
 const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random()));
 if(u<.3)return .05+.25*(u/.3);
 if(u<.9)return .3+.4*((u-.3)/.6);
 return .7+.3*((u-.9)/.1);
}

/** Prefer the nearest enemy in the middle 30-80% of directional screen reach. */
export function molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random=Math.random){
 const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
 function reach(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
  const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
  const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
  return Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY));
 }
 let nearest=null,nearestDistance=Infinity;
 for(const enemy of enemies){
  const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=target.x-body.x,dy=target.y-body.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const fraction=distance/reach(Math.atan2(dy,dx));
  if(fraction>=.3&&fraction<=.8&&distance<nearestDistance){nearest=target;nearestDistance=distance;}
 }
 if(nearest)return {x:nearest.x,y:nearest.y};
 const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=reach(angle)*molotovThrowDistance(random);
 return {x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
}

export function createMolotovAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,cooldown=0,time=0,enabled=true,throws=[],fires=[],shots=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;throws=[];fires=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,stats,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const enemies=getAllEnemies();
  for(let i=0;i<stats.count;i++){
   const {x,y}=molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random);
   throws.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:x,toY:y,age:0,
    flight:Math.max(.12,Math.hypot(x-body.x,y-body.y)/molotovSettings.speed),
    radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:stats.count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,molotovLevelStats(weapon.level),viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(molotovSettings.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=throws.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=throws[i];b.age+=step;const progress=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*progress;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*progress;
    if(progress>=1){fires.push({...b,x:b.toX,y:b.toY,age:0,hits:new Map()});throws.splice(i,1);}}
   const enemies=getAllEnemies(),living=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
   for(let i=fires.length-1;i>=0;i--){const zone=fires[i];zone.age+=step;
    if(zone.age>=zone.duration){fires.splice(i,1);continue;}
    for(const id of zone.hits.keys())if(!living.has(id))zone.hits.delete(id);
    for(const enemy of enemies){if(time-(zone.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<molotovSettings.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
     const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=t.x-zone.x,dy=t.y-zone.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/t.rx,dy/distance/t.ry):0;
     if(distance>zone.radius+extent)continue;zone.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'molotov-cocktail',molotovSettings.damage,zone.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:zone.count,hitCooldownFrames:45}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'molotov-cocktail'});
     damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true});
    }
   }
  }
 }
 function drawGround(context,camera){for(const zone of fires)drawMolotovNapalm(context,camera,zone);}
 function drawThrows(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of throws){const arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*b.age/b.flight)*45;
  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y-arc);context.rotate(b.age*7);context.fillStyle='#746533';context.fillRect(-4,-7,8,14);context.fillStyle='#d3cca5';context.fillRect(-2,-11,4,5);context.fillStyle='#ffb64d';context.fillRect(-2,-14,4,4);context.restore();}context.restore();}
 return {ready:molotovAnimationReady,reset,update,drawGround,drawThrows,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get fireCount(){return fires.length;},get projectileCount(){return throws.length;}};
}

const enemies=new Map(),hits=[],draws=[];const c=vm.createContext({getAllEnemies:()=>[...enemies.values()],getCombatHitbox:p=>({x:p.x,y:p.y}),getEnemyHurtbox:e=>({...e,rx:5,ry:5}),damageEnemy:(...a)=>hits.push(a),totalWeaponDamage:(p,id,base,bonuses)=>base*bonuses.reduce((a,b)=>a*(1+b/100),1),rollAttackDamage:(p,damage)=>({damage,type:'normal'}),ensureCombatStats:p=>p.combatStats,stationaryWeaponIntervalScale:()=>1,molotovAnimationReady:Promise.resolve(),drawMolotovNapalm:(ctx,camera,zone)=>draws.push({...zone})});
for(const file of ['game-config','molotov-cocktail'])vm.runInContext(fs.readFileSync(`Development/${file}.js`,'utf8').replace(/^import .*;\r?\n/gm,'').replaceAll('export ',''),c);const run=s=>vm.runInContext(s,c);

import { molotovSkillSettings, molotovSkillThrowCount } from './game-config.js';
import { weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { molotovSettings, molotovLevelStats, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { molotovAnimationReady, drawMolotovNapalm } from './molotov-animation.js';

/** Explicit fallback odds: 30% close, 60% middle, 10% far; randomized within each band. */
export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
 const u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random()));
 if(u<.3)return .05+.25*(u/.3);
 if(u<.9)return .3+.4*((u-.3)/.6);
 return .7+.3*((u-.9)/.1);
}

/** Prefer the nearest enemy in the middle 30-80% of directional screen reach. */
export function molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random=Math.random){
 const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
 function reach(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
  const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
  const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
  return Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY));
 }
 let nearest=null,nearestDistance=Infinity;
 for(const enemy of enemies){
  const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=target.x-body.x,dy=target.y-body.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const fraction=distance/reach(Math.atan2(dy,dx));
  if(fraction>=.3&&fraction<=.8&&distance<nearestDistance){nearest=target;nearestDistance=distance;}
 }
 if(nearest)return {x:nearest.x,y:nearest.y};
 const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=reach(angle)*molotovThrowDistance(random);
 return {x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
}

export function createMolotovAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,cooldown=0,time=0,enabled=true,throws=[],fires=[],shots=0,burst=null;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;throws=[];fires=[];shots=0;burst=null;}
 function launch(player,stats,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const enemies=getAllEnemies();
  for(let i=0;i<stats.count;i++){
   const landing=molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random),distanceMultiplier=stats.distanceMultiplier||1;
   const x=body.x+(landing.x-body.x)*distanceMultiplier,y=body.y+(landing.y-body.y)*distanceMultiplier;
   throws.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:x,toY:y,age:0,
    flight:Math.max(.12,Math.hypot(x-body.x,y-body.y)/molotovSettings.speed),
    radius:stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:stats.splitCount??stats.count,damageMultiplier:stats.damageMultiplier??1,exSkill:Boolean(stats.exSkill),visualScale:stats.exSkill?molotovSkillSettings.sizeMultiplier:1});shots++;
  }
 }
 function cast(player,viewport=null,damageMultiplier=1){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon)return false;
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}const stats=molotovLevelStats(weapon.level);
  burst={remaining:molotovSkillThrowCount(weapon.level),timer:0,viewport,stats:{...stats,count:1,splitCount:stats.count,radius:stats.radius*molotovSkillSettings.sizeMultiplier,duration:stats.duration*molotovSkillSettings.durationMultiplier,distanceMultiplier:molotovSkillSettings.distanceMultiplier,damageMultiplier:molotovSkillSettings.damageMultiplier*Math.max(0,damageMultiplier),exSkill:true}};return true;
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(burst&&burst.timer<=1e-8){launch(player,burst.stats,burst.viewport||viewport);burst.remaining--;burst.timer=molotovSkillSettings.throwInterval;if(!burst.remaining)burst=null;}
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,molotovLevelStats(weapon.level),viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(molotovSettings.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60,burst&&burst.timer>1e-8?burst.timer:Infinity);left-=step;time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);if(burst)burst.timer=Math.max(0,burst.timer-step);
   for(let i=throws.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=throws[i];b.age+=step;const progress=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*progress;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*progress;
    if(progress>=1){fires.push({...b,x:b.toX,y:b.toY,age:0,hits:new Map()});throws.splice(i,1);}}
   const enemies=getAllEnemies(),living=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
   for(let i=fires.length-1;i>=0;i--){const zone=fires[i];zone.age+=step;
    if(zone.age>=zone.duration){fires.splice(i,1);continue;}

     if(distance>zone.radius+extent)continue;zone.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'molotov-cocktail',molotovSettings.damage,zone.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:zone.count,hitCooldownFrames:45}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'molotov-cocktail',damageMod:zone.damageMultiplier,skillAttack:zone.exSkill});
     damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'molotov-cocktail'});
    }
   }
  }
 }
 function drawGround(context,camera){for(const zone of fires)drawMolotovNapalm(context,camera,zone);}
 function drawThrows(context,camera){context.save();for(const b of throws){const arc=Math.sin(Math.PI*b.age/b.flight)*45;
  context.save();context.translate(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y-arc);context.rotate(b.age*7);if(b.visualScale!==1)context.scale(b.visualScale,b.visualScale);context.fillStyle='#746533';context.fillRect(-4,-7,8,14);context.fillStyle='#d3cca5';context.fillRect(-2,-11,4,5);context.fillStyle='#ffb64d';context.fillRect(-2,-14,4,4);context.restore();}context.restore();}
 return {ready:molotovAnimationReady,cast,reset,update,drawGround,drawThrows,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get burstRemaining(){return burst?.remaining||0;},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get fireCount(){return fires.length;},get projectileCount(){return throws.length;}};

export function throwingCardSpiral(age,startRadius=32){
 const pitch=throwingCardsSettings.pitch,distance=throwingCardsSettings.speed*Math.max(0,age);

}
/** Smoothly steer the spiral's own center; retarget without teleporting its orbit. */
export function advanceCardSpiralCenter(card,targets,delta){

import { studentHandbookSettings, studentHandbookLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier, weaponKnockbackMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { beginKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Books grow out from the player and shrink back into the player within their lifetime. */
export function studentHandbookPose(age,duration,retiringAt=null,retiringScale=1){
 const smooth=t=>{const p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));return p*p*(3-2*p);};
 const scale=retiringAt===null?Math.min(smooth(age/studentHandbookSettings.emergeSeconds),smooth((duration-age)/studentHandbookSettings.returnSeconds)):
  retiringScale*(1-smooth((age-retiringAt)/studentHandbookSettings.returnSeconds));
 return {scale,alpha:scale};
}
/** Books materialize equally spaced around the player; each owns its hit budget/cooldown. */
export function createStudentHandbookAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=studentHandbookSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,books=[],fadingTrails=[],shots=0,image=null;
 const ready=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise(resolve=>{image=new Image();image.onload=resolve;image.onerror=()=>{image=null;resolve();};image.src=new URL('../sprites/attacks/Arius Student Handbook.png',import.meta.url).href;});
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;books=[];fadingTrails=[];shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,angle){
  const stats=studentHandbookLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=weaponSizeMultiplier(player),radius=s.orbitRadius*area;
  const count=startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'student-handbook',stats.count);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const phase=angle+i*Math.PI*2/count;books.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,phase,angle:phase,age:0,retiringAt:null,retiringScale:1,trail:[],trailElapsed:0,area,radius,count,duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hitsLeft:s.hitLimit,hits:new Map()});shots++;}
 }
 function ageTrail(trail,delta){for(const ghost of trail)ghost.age+=delta;while(trail.length&&trail[0].age>=s.trailDuration)trail.shift();}
 function finish(index){const b=books[index];if(b.trail.length)fadingTrails.push({area:b.area,trail:b.trail});books.splice(index,1);}
 function update(delta,player,angle=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='student-handbook');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta,index=null;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,angle);cooldown=Math.max(s.minimumInterval,attackTimeFormula(s.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent));}
   const dt=Math.min(left,1/120,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/120);left-=dt;time+=dt;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-dt);
   for(let i=fadingTrails.length-1;i>=0;i--){ageTrail(fadingTrails[i].trail,dt);if(!fadingTrails[i].trail.length)fadingTrails.splice(i,1);}
   if(!books.length)continue;if(!index)index=createEnemySpatialIndex(getAllEnemies(),getEnemyHurtbox);
   const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
   for(let i=books.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=books[i],from={x:b.x,y:b.y};b.age+=dt;
    const pose=studentHandbookPose(b.age,b.duration,b.retiringAt,b.retiringScale);
    if((b.retiringAt===null&&b.age>=b.duration-1e-8)||(b.retiringAt!==null&&b.age-b.retiringAt>=s.returnSeconds-1e-8)){finish(i);continue;}
    if(b.retiringAt===null)b.angle=b.phase+s.speed/b.radius*b.age;
    b.x=center.x+Math.cos(b.angle)*b.radius*pose.scale;b.y=center.y+Math.sin(b.angle)*b.radius*pose.scale;
    ageTrail(b.trail,dt);b.trailElapsed+=dt;
    if(b.trailElapsed>=s.trailInterval-1e-8){b.trailElapsed%=s.trailInterval;b.trail.push({x:b.x,y:b.y,angle:Math.sin(b.angle)*.12,scale:pose.scale,age:0});if(b.trail.length>s.trailCount)b.trail.shift();}
    if(b.retiringAt!==null||pose.scale<=0)continue;
    const radius=s.hitRadius*b.area*pose.scale;
    const candidates=index.querySegment(from,b,radius).filter(enemy=>{if(!getEnemy(enemy.id)||time-(b.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8)return false;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,b.x,b.y);});
    for(const enemy of candidates){
     if(!getEnemy(enemy.id))continue;b.hits.set(enemy.id,time);
     const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'student-handbook',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'student-handbook'});
     if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true,weaponId:'student-handbook'})===false)continue;
     b.hitsLeft--;const target=getEnemy(enemy.id);
     if(target){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),direction=Math.atan2(body.y-center.y,body.x-center.x),distance=s.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
      const motion=beginKnockback(target,Math.cos(direction)*distance,Math.sin(direction)*distance,s.knockbackSeconds);
      if(motion){target.skillKnockback=motion;target.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(target.knockbackMovementRemaining||0,s.knockbackSeconds);}
     }
     if(b.hitsLeft<=0)break;
    }
    if(b.hitsLeft<=0){b.retiringAt=b.age;b.retiringScale=pose.scale;}
   }
  }
 }
 function drawPose(context,camera,b,pose,alpha,shrink=1){
  const scale=b.area*pose.scale*shrink;if(scale<=0)return;
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=alpha;context.translate(pose.x-camera.x,pose.y-camera.y);context.rotate(pose.angle);context.scale(scale,scale);context.drawImage(image,48,12,200,228,-s.width/2,-s.height/2,s.width,s.height);context.restore();
 }
 function drawTrail(context,camera,b){for(const ghost of b.trail){const fade=Math.max(0,1-ghost.age/s.trailDuration);drawPose(context,camera,b,ghost,.25*fade*fade,fade);}}
 function draw(context,camera){
  if(!image?.complete||!image.naturalWidth)return;
  for(const b of fadingTrails)drawTrail(context,camera,b);
  for(const b of books){drawTrail(context,camera,b);const pose=studentHandbookPose(b.age,b.duration,b.retiringAt,b.retiringScale);drawPose(context,camera,b,{x:b.x,y:b.y,angle:Math.sin(b.angle)*.12,scale:pose.scale},pose.alpha);}
 }
 return {ready,update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;},get projectileCount(){return books.filter(b=>b.retiringAt===null).length;}};
}

    /** Trigger a defined slot directly for effect testing, bypassing its current cooldown. */
    castSlot(slot) {
      if (isPaused()) return;
      const result = adminSkillResult(getPlayer(), slot);
      if (!result.valid) { setStatus(result.reason); return; }
      cancel('admin');
      setSkillCooldown(result.weapon, result.weapon.successCooldown??skillCastSettings.successCooldown);
      onRecognized({ ...result, player: getPlayer(), angle: getCastAngle(), predictions: [] });
      setStatus(`Admin: cast slot ${slot + 1}.`);
    },
    get phase() { return state.phase; },
    update(delta) {
      advanceSkillCooldowns(getCharacters(), delta);
      if (state.phase !== 'idle' && (state.owner !== getPlayer() || !equippedSkills(getPlayer()).includes(state.weapon))) cancel('switch');
      if (state.phase === 'drawing' && (drawingCanvas.width !== canvas.width || drawingCanvas.height !== canvas.height)) cancel('resize');
      state.update(delta);
      if (state.phase === 'drawing') updateTimer();

    }
  };

/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'student-handbook' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,strictRulesReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'throwing-cards' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,skilledThrowReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'molotov-cocktail' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,molotovReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}

 return {valid,skillId:'skilled-throw',label:'Skilled Throw',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw the diagonal L-shaped outline.'};
}

/** Each attack splashes once; independent splashes use the configured per-target hit cooldown. */
export function createWaterDousingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=waterDousingSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,splashes=[],hits=new Map(),shots=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;splashes=[];hits.clear();shots=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,angle){
  const stats=waterDousingLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),radius=stats.radius*weaponSizeMultiplier(player);
  splashes.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,angle,radius,age:0});shots++;
  const enemies=getAllEnemies(),live=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));for(const id of hits.keys())if(!live.has(id))hits.delete(id);
  for(const enemy of enemies){
   if(time-(hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<s.hitCooldown-1e-8||!waterConeHits(getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),body.x,body.y,angle,radius))continue;
   hits.set(enemy.id,time);
   const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'water-dousing',s.damage,stats.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:s.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'water-dousing'});
   if(damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true})===false)continue;
   const target=getEnemy(enemy.id);if(!target)continue;
   const b=getEnemyHurtbox(target),a=Math.atan2(b.y-body.y,b.x-body.x),distance=stats.knockbackSpeed*s.knockbackSeconds*weaponKnockbackMultiplier(player);
   const motion=beginKnockback(target,Math.cos(a)*distance,Math.sin(a)*distance,s.knockbackSeconds);
   if(motion){target.skillKnockback=motion;target.waterRootDelay=s.knockbackSeconds;}
   if(stats.rootSeconds){target.waterRootDelay=motion?s.knockbackSeconds:0;target.waterRootRemaining=stats.rootSeconds;}
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,angle=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='water-dousing');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(!(delta>0))return;
  let left=delta;while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){fire(player,weapon,angle);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(waterDousingLevelStats(weapon.level).interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);left-=step;
   for(let i=splashes.length-1;i>=0;i--){splashes[i].age+=step;if(splashes[i].age>=s.duration+waterStreamSettings.sweepSeconds)splashes.splice(i,1);}
  }
 }
 function draw(context,camera){
  if(!owner)return;
  const origin=getCombatHitbox(owner,false);
  for(const splash of splashes){
   // Keep the whole ongoing sweep attached while each droplet ages outward.
   const drops=waterStreamDroplets({...splash,x:origin.x,y:origin.y});if(!drops.length)continue;
   context.save();
   // A narrow translucent strand joins the water, rather than filling the entire cone.
   for(let i=1;i<drops.length;i++){
    const a=drops[i-1],b=drops[i],alpha=Math.min(a.alpha,b.alpha);
    context.strokeStyle=`rgba(79,196,246,${alpha*.28})`;context.lineWidth=(a.size+b.size)*1.7;context.lineCap='round';
    context.beginPath();context.moveTo(a.x-camera.x,a.y-camera.y);context.lineTo(b.x-camera.x,b.y-camera.y);context.stroke();
    context.strokeStyle=`rgba(190,246,255,${alpha*.55})`;context.lineWidth=(a.size+b.size)*.5;context.stroke();
   }
   // Small tapered droplets follow their own outward trajectory after release.
   for(const drop of drops){
    context.save();context.translate(drop.x-camera.x,drop.y-camera.y);context.rotate(drop.angle);context.globalAlpha=drop.alpha;
    const r=drop.size;context.fillStyle='rgba(72,192,244,.28)';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(0,0,r*2.7,r*1.6,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();
    context.fillStyle='rgba(127,224,255,.9)';context.beginPath();context.moveTo(-r*3,0);context.bezierCurveTo(-r,-r*.8,r*.9,-r*1.2,r*1.4,0);context.bezierCurveTo(r*.9,r*1.2,-r,r*.8,-r*3,0);context.fill();
    context.fillStyle='rgba(224,253,255,.85)';context.beginPath();context.ellipse(r*.35,-r*.22,r*.7,r*.28,0,0,Math.PI*2);context.fill();context.restore();
   }
   context.restore();
  }
 }
 return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);},get shotsFired(){return shots;}};
}
import {tuningPerk,slowdownTuningSettings} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {damageEnemy} from './world-state.js';
/** Temporary movement reduction, independent of permanent speed and knockback. */
export function applySlowdown(enemy,percent,seconds=5){
  if(enemy.hp<=0||!(percent>0)||!(seconds>0))return false;
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0,seconds);
  enemy.slowdownPercent=percent;return true;
}
export function updateSlowdown(enemy,delta){
  enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  enemy.flattenedRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.flattenedRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  const dt=Math.max(0,delta),delay=enemy.waterRootDelay||0;
  enemy.waterRootDelay=Math.max(0,delay-dt);
  enemy.waterRootRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.waterRootRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,dt-delay));
  enemy.slowdownRemaining=Math.max(0,(enemy.slowdownRemaining||0)-Math.max(0,delta));
  if(enemy.slowdownRemaining<1e-6){enemy.slowdownRemaining=0;enemy.slowdownPercent=0;}
}
export function slowdownMultiplier(enemy){if(enemy.knockbackMovementRemaining>0||enemy.flattenedRemaining>0||enemy.waterRootDelay>0||enemy.waterRootRemaining>0)return 0;return enemy.slowdownRemaining>0?1-Math.min(100,Math.max(0,enemy.slowdownPercent||0))/100:1;}

/** Single bonus hit; does not recursively trigger itself or repeatedly tick. */
export function trySlowdownTuningHit({player,enemy,rollDamage,random=Math.random}){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  if(main!=='plana-umbrella'||!player.tuningParts||enemy.hp<=0)return false;
  const chance=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowChance');if(!chance||random()>=chance)return false;
  if(!applySlowdown(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowPercent'),slowdownTuningSettings.seconds))return false;
  const hit=rollDamage(enemy,tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'slowDamagePercent')/100);
  damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{slowdownTuning:true});return true;
}

}

export const damageFlashDuration = 240; // EDIT total pulse length in milliseconds.
const riseDuration = 45; // Fast gradual rise, followed by a longer fade out.
const whiteSprites = new WeakMap();

/** Return a smooth white-tint intensity, never a full-screen or rectangular flash. */
export function getDamageFlashOpacity(character) {
  const elapsed = character.damageFlashElapsed;
  if (elapsed === undefined || elapsed < 0 || elapsed >= damageFlashDuration) return 0;
  const progress = elapsed < riseDuration
    ? elapsed / riseDuration
    : 1 - (elapsed - riseDuration) / (damageFlashDuration - riseDuration);
  const smooth = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);
  return smooth * 0.85;
}

/** Advance visual feedback independently of whether movement AI is paused. */
export function advanceDamageFlash(character, delta) {
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed === undefined) return;
  character.damageFlashElapsed += delta * 1000;
  if (character.damageFlashElapsed >= damageFlashDuration) {
    delete character.damageFlashElapsed;
  }
}

/** Cache a white silhouette retaining the original image's transparent pixels. */
export function getWhiteSprite(image) {
  if (!whiteSprites.has(image)) {
    const surface = document.createElement('canvas');
    surface.width = image.naturalWidth;
    surface.height = image.naturalHeight;
    const context = surface.getContext('2d');
    context.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-in';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, surface.width, surface.height);
    whiteSprites.set(image, surface);
  }
  return whiteSprites.get(image);
}

/** Damage-receiving sprite bounds are separate from the small contact-damage ellipse. */
function unflattenedEnemyHurtbox(character) {
  const size=character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize;
  const bounds=character.spriteHurtbox||{offsetX:0,offsetY:0,width:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2,height:size-spriteDisplayPadding*2};
  const oval=bounds.mask?.ellipse;
  if(oval)return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX+(oval.x-.5)*bounds.width*(bounds.mirrored?-1:1),
    y:character.y+bounds.offsetY+(oval.y-.5)*bounds.height,
    rx:oval.rx*bounds.width,ry:oval.ry*bounds.height,shape:'ellipse',
    coverage:oval.coverage,emptyFraction:oval.emptyFraction,meetsTargets:oval.meetsTargets};
  return {x:character.x+bounds.offsetX,y:character.y+bounds.offsetY,
    rx:Math.max(1,bounds.width/2),ry:Math.max(1,bounds.height/2),shape:'rectangle',
    mask:bounds.mask,mirrored:bounds.mirrored,maskWidth:bounds.width,maskHeight:bounds.height};
}

 const body=unflattenedEnemyHurtbox(character);if(!(character.flattenedRemaining>0))return body;
 const foot=character.y+(character.spriteSize||normalSpriteSize)/2-spriteDisplayPadding+(character.bossVisualOffsetY||0);
 return {...body,x:character.x+(body.x-character.x)*1.12,y:foot+(body.y-foot)*.32,rx:body.rx*1.12,ry:body.ry*.32,
   maskWidth:body.maskWidth?body.maskWidth*1.12:undefined,maskHeight:body.maskHeight?body.maskHeight*.32:undefined};
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

// Enemy damage scales with current player level and active survival minutes.
export const enemyDamageScaling = { base: 1, levelDivisor: 6, minutesDivisor: 4 };

/** floor(enemyBase * variantMultiplier * (1 + (level/6) * (minutes/4))). */
export function enemyContactDamageFormula(baseDamage, level, survivalSeconds, variantMultiplier = 1) {
  const s = enemyDamageScaling;
  const minutes = Math.max(0, survivalSeconds) / 60;
  const scale = s.base + (Math.max(1, level) / s.levelDivisor) * (minutes / s.minutesDivisor);

import {stunnedFrames} from './stunned-animation.js';
import {loadGifAnimation,gifFrameAt} from './gif-animation.js';
import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const stunnedSettings={testSeconds:3,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/stunned.gif',headGap:2,headInset:.35};
const animation={gifFrames:stunnedFrames};
export const stunnedReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():loadGifAnimation(animation);
export function applyStunned(enemy,seconds=stunnedSettings.testSeconds){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0))enemy.stunVisualElapsed=0;
  enemy.stunRemaining=Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function stunVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyStunned(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawStunnedStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.stunRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!animation.animationFrames?.length)return;
  const stars=animation.animationFrames[gifFrameAt(animation.animationFrames,(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)*1000)].image;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),width=Math.max(32,Math.min(140,body.rx*1.6)),height=width*stars.naturalHeight/stars.naturalWidth;
  context.save();context.drawImage(stars,body.x-camera.x-width/2,body.y-camera.y-body.ry+body.ry*2*stunnedSettings.headInset-stunnedSettings.headGap-height,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createStunnedAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('#admin-stun-visible').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=stunVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Stunned ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.65,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=enemy.spriteSize||Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)*2,
    height=size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,enemy.x-camera.x-width/2,enemy.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}
export function createFrozenAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=freezeVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Frozen ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

/** Visual pursuit continues while the control layer holds world movement/attacks. */
export function animateFrozenEnemy(enemy,player,delta){
  const dx=player.x-enemy.x,dy=player.y-enemy.y;
  const directions=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];
  if(dx||dy)enemy.direction=directions[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8];
  if(dx)enemy.facing=dx>0?'right':'left';
  enemy.moving=true;enemy.elapsed=(enemy.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.attack)enemy.attack.elapsed=(enemy.attack.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.bossAction?.clip)enemy.frozenPoseElapsed=(enemy.frozenPoseElapsed??(enemy.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000)+delta*1000;
}

import {updateRateUpWindow} from './rate-up-tuning.js';

export function createFrozenAdmin({root,getEnemies,getCamera,getSize}){
  const status=root.querySelector('[role="status"]');
  root.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click',()=>{const {width,height}=getSize();const count=freezeVisibleEnemies(getEnemies(),getCamera(),width,height);status.textContent=`Frozen ${count} onscreen enemies for 3 seconds.`;});
}

/** Visual pursuit continues while the control layer holds world movement/attacks. */
export function animateFrozenEnemy(enemy,player,delta){
  const dx=player.x-enemy.x,dy=player.y-enemy.y;
  const directions=['up','upRight','right','downRight','down','downLeft','left','upLeft'];
  if(dx||dy)enemy.direction=directions[(Math.round(Math.atan2(dx,-dy)/(Math.PI/4))+8)%8];
  if(dx)enemy.facing=dx>0?'right':'left';
  enemy.moving=true;enemy.elapsed=(enemy.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.attack)enemy.attack.elapsed=(enemy.attack.elapsed||0)+delta*1000;
  if(enemy.bossAction?.clip)enemy.frozenPoseElapsed=(enemy.frozenPoseElapsed??(enemy.bossAction.elapsed||0)*1000)+delta*1000;
}

import {getEnemyHurtbox} from './combat-hitboxes.js';
export const frozenSettings={duration:3,opacity:.55,coverageScale:1.65,source:'../sprites/icons/effects/frozen.png'};
let ice;
export const frozenReady=typeof Image==='undefined'?Promise.resolve():new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{ice=new Image();ice.onload=resolve;ice.onerror=reject;ice.src=frozenSettings.source;});
export function applyFrozen(enemy,seconds=frozenSettings.duration){
  if(!(seconds>0)||enemy.hp===0)return false;
  enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(enemy.frozenRemaining||0,seconds);enemy.moving=false;return true;
}
export function freezeVisibleEnemies(enemies,camera,width,height){
  let count=0;for(const enemy of enemies){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
    if(body.x+body.rx<camera.x||body.x-body.rx>camera.x+width||body.y+body.ry<camera.y||body.y-body.ry>camera.y+height)continue;
    if(applyFrozen(enemy))count++;
  }return count;
}
export function drawFrozenStatus(context,camera,enemy){
  if(!(enemy.frozenRemaining>0)||enemy.hp===0||!ice?.naturalWidth)return;
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),size=enemy.spriteSize||Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)*2,
    height=size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,
    width=Math.max(size*frozenSettings.coverageScale,height*ice.naturalWidth/ice.naturalHeight);
  context.save();context.globalAlpha=frozenSettings.opacity;
  context.drawImage(ice,enemy.x-camera.x-width/2,enemy.y-camera.y-height/2,width,height);context.restore();
}

}

        // A chasing NPC can reach contact during this step, even with a stationary player.
        updateNpcContact(npc, player, playerMotion, 0, moveKnockback, getSurvivalSeconds());
        if (updateYuukaPresence(npc, camera, canvas.width, canvas.height, time)) {
          removeEnemy(npc.id); // Escaping grants no kills, EXP or credits.
          refresh();
        }
      }

/** Return a source rectangle using the sheet's uneven per-column row boundaries. */
function getFrameRectangle(character, frame) {
  const facing = character.horizontalFacingOnly ? character.facing : character.direction;
  const row = character.attack
    ? character.attacks[character.attack.name].rows[character.attack.facing]
    : !character.moving && character.idleRows?.[facing] !== undefined
    ? character.idleRows[facing]
    : character.rows[facing];
  // Attack artwork can exceed the grid cell. Custom rectangles keep the tank's
  // anchor fixed even when a muzzle flash needs a wider crop.
  const custom = character.layout.frames?.[row]?.[frame];
  if (custom) return custom;
  const { columnEdges, rowEdges } = character.layout;
  return {
    x: columnEdges[frame],
    y: rowEdges[frame][row],
    width: columnEdges[frame + 1] - columnEdges[frame],
    height: rowEdges[frame][row + 1] - rowEdges[frame][row],
    anchorX: character.layout.anchorX?.[row]?.[frame],
    footY: character.layout.footY?.[frame]?.[row] ?? rowEdges[frame][row + 1]
  };
}

/** Select a direction-specific walking cycle, or hold frame zero when idle. */
function getAnimationFrame(character) {
  if (character.attack) {
    const attack = character.attacks[character.attack.name];
    return Math.min(character.layout.columnEdges.length - 2,
      Math.floor(character.attack.elapsed / attack.frameDuration));
  }
  if (!character.moving) return 0;
  const frames = character.walkFrames?.[character.direction] ||
    character.frameSequence || [1, 2, 3, 4];
  const duration = character.frameDuration || frameDuration;
  return frames[Math.floor(character.elapsed / duration) % frames.length];
}

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;
    enemy.moving=false;return true; // Freeze also holds knockback and attack timers.
  }
  const stunned = enemy.stunRemaining > 0;
  if(stunned)enemy.stunVisualElapsed=(enemy.stunVisualElapsed||0)+delta;
  else delete enemy.stunVisualElapsed;
  if (!stunned && !enemy.skillKnockback) return false;
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(0, (enemy.stunRemaining || 0) - delta);
  if (enemy.stunRemaining < 1e-6) enemy.stunRemaining = 0;
  const knockback = enemy.skillKnockback;
  if (knockback) {
    if (!advanceKnockback(enemy, knockback, delta, move)) delete enemy.skillKnockback;
  }
  if (stunned) enemy.moving = false;
  return stunned;
}

/** Invert spiral arc length so projectile speed is constant while its orbit expands. */
export function throwingCardSpiral(age,startRadius=32){
 const pitch=throwingCardsSettings.pitch,distance=throwingCardsSettings.speed*Math.max(0,age);
 const primitive=r=>(r*Math.hypot(r,pitch)+pitch*pitch*Math.asinh(r/pitch))/2;
 const target=primitive(startRadius)+pitch*distance;let radius=Math.sqrt(startRadius*startRadius+2*pitch*distance);
 for(let i=0;i<6;i++)radius-=(primitive(radius)-target)/Math.hypot(radius,pitch);
 return {radius,angle:(radius-startRadius)/pitch};
}
/** Smoothly steer the spiral's own center; retarget without teleporting its orbit. */
export function advanceCardSpiralCenter(card,targets,delta){
 card.seekRemaining=(card.seekRemaining||0)-delta;
 let target=targets.find(enemy=>enemy.id===card.targetId&&enemy.hp>0);
 if(!target||card.seekRemaining<=0){
  let nearest=Infinity;target=null;
  for(const enemy of targets){if(!(enemy.hp>0))continue;const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),distance=Math.hypot(body.x-card.centerX,body.y-card.centerY);if(distance<nearest){nearest=distance;target=enemy;}}
  card.targetId=target?.id;card.seekRemaining=.25;
 }
 let vx=0,vy=0;
 if(target){const body=getEnemyHurtbox(target),dx=body.x-card.centerX,dy=body.y-card.centerY,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),speed=throwingCardsSettings.centerSeekSpeed*Math.min(1,distance/80);if(distance>1e-8){vx=dx/distance*speed;vy=dy/distance*speed;}}

}

/** Match handwritten 1ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Å“6 locally, without downloading or calling either AI model. */
export function recognizeAdminDigit(strokes) {
  const bounds = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!bounds) return null;
  const width = bounds.right - bounds.left, height = bounds.bottom - bounds.top;
  if (height > 0 && width / height < .18) return 1;
  const ranked = Object.entries(adminDigitTemplates).map(([digit, template]) =>
    ({ digit: Number(digit), score: drawingAccuracy(strokes, template) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  return ranked[0].score >= .45 && ranked[0].score - ranked[1].score >= .025 ? ranked[0].digit : null;
}

/** Resolve a slot only when it contains a weapon with an implemented EX effect. */
export function adminSkillResult(player, slot) {
  const weapon = player.attackSlots?.[slot];
  const skillId = skillIds[weapon?.id];
  return skillId ? { valid: true, adminTest: true, weapon, skillId,
    label: weapon.skillName || weapon.name || weapon.id, score: 1, accuracy: skillCastSettings.accuracyAverage,
    damageMultiplier: skillCastSettings.damageAverage, components: [] }
    : { valid: false, reason: `Slot ${slot + 1} has no implemented EX skill.` };
}
import { decagrammatonReferenceStrokes } from './decagrammaton-ultimate.js';

/** Require interior ink in both symbol regions before allowing CLIP to rescue rough geometry. */
function hasBothSymbols(strokes) {
  const b = drawingBounds(strokes);
  if (!b) return false;
  const cx = (b.left + b.right) / 2, cy = (b.top + b.bottom) / 2;
  const w = b.right - b.left, h = b.bottom - b.top;
  if (!(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return false;
  const inner = strokes.flat().filter(p => Math.hypot((p.x-cx)/(w/2), (p.y-cy)/(h/2)) < .76);
  return inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y < cy && p.x > cx+w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x < cx-w*.04) &&
    inner.some(p => p.y > cy && p.x > cx+w*.04);
}

/** Combine full-symbol CLIP, isolated QuickDraw parts and forgiving spatial validation. */
export async function recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  if(!isCurrent())return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'){
    const accuracy=drawingAccuracy(strokes,decagrammatonReferenceStrokes());
    const valid=accuracy>=.72;return {valid,skillId:'decagrammaton-ultimate',label:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',score:accuracy,accuracy,matchAccuracy:accuracy,damageMultiplier:1,reason:valid?undefined:'Draw a square overlaid with a diamond.'};
  }
  if(weapon?.id==='decagrammaton')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if(weapon?.id==='princess-key')return recognizePrincessKeyPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'water-dousing') return recognizeSplashPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'student-handbook') return recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'throwing-cards') return recognizeSkilledThrowPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'molotov-cocktail') return recognizeMolotovPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'luminous-nova') return recognizeLuminousNovaPattern(strokes,recognizer,isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id === 'aris-laser') return recognizeSupernovaPattern(strokes, recognizer, isCurrent);
  if (weapon?.id !== 'plana-umbrella') return { valid: false, reason: 'No drawing skill is defined for this weapon yet.' };
  if(recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid)return {valid:false,reason:'This is the Strict Rules circle-and-plus pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  // CLIP can confuse overlapping frames with Umbrella's enclosing circle. Local geometry wins.
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return {valid:false,reason:'This is a linked-frame pattern, not Umbrella.'};
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  strokes = normalizeSkillStrokes(strokes);
  const pattern = segmentPlanaPattern(strokes);
  const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes);
  let clipPredictions = [], clipError;
  try {
    if (recognizer.recognizeSymbol) clipPredictions = await recognizer.recognizeSymbol(drawingModelImage(strokes));
  } catch (error) {
    // Download/inference failure must not disable an otherwise recognized geometric cast.
    clipError = error.message;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  const clipMatch = clipPredictions[0]?.label === 'a hand drawn circle enclosing an arrow above an X cross' &&
    clipPredictions[0].score >= skillCastSettings.clipMinimumScore;
  const rescued = clipMatch && accuracy >= skillCastSettings.referenceMinimum && hasBothSymbols(strokes);
  if (!pattern.valid && !rescued) return { ...pattern, clipPredictions, accuracy };
  const components = [];
  // When geometry cannot reliably split rough ink, ask QuickDraw about the whole sketch.
  const parts = pattern.valid ? pattern.parts : [{ name: 'whole pattern', strokes }];
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    try {
      const predictions = await recognizer.recognize(drawingModelImage(part.strokes));
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions });
    } catch (error) {
      components.push({ name: part.name, predictions: [], error: error.message });
    }
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
  return { valid: true, skillId: 'plana-umbrella-launch', label: 'Plana: Umbrella Launch',
    score: pattern.valid ? pattern.score : clipPredictions[0].score,
    accuracy, damageMultiplier: skillDamageMultiplier(accuracy), components, clipPredictions, clipError };
}


/** Let the drawing identify a ready EX skill; autoattacks never require weapon selection. */
export async function recognizeLoadoutPattern(strokes, skills, recognizer, isCurrent = () => true) {
  const strict=recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes,isCurrent);
  if(strict.valid){const weapon=skills.find(w=>w.id==='student-handbook'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0));return weapon?{...strict,weapon}:{valid:false,reason:'Strict Rules is not equipped or is on cooldown.'};}
  let bestMatch = null, bestFailure = null;
  const validMatches = [];
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    if (!isCurrent()) return { valid: false, cancelled: true };
    const result = await recognizeWeaponPattern(strokes, weapon, recognizer, isCurrent);
    const accuracy = ['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?drawingAccuracy(strokes,princessKeyReferenceStrokes()):weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes, supernovaReferenceStrokes()) :
      weapon.id === 'water-dousing' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,splashReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'student-handbook' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,strictRulesReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'throwing-cards' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,skilledThrowReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'molotov-cocktail' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,molotovReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'luminous-nova' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes,luminousNovaReferenceStrokes()) : weapon.id === 'plana-umbrella' ? drawingAccuracy(strokes) : 0;
    const candidate = {...result, weapon, matchAccuracy: result.matchAccuracy??accuracy};
    if (result.valid) validMatches.push(candidate);
    if (result.valid && (!bestMatch || candidate.matchAccuracy > bestMatch.matchAccuracy)) bestMatch = candidate;
    if (!bestFailure || accuracy > bestFailure.matchAccuracy) bestFailure = candidate;
  }
  if (!isCurrent()) return {valid:false,cancelled:true};
  validMatches.sort((a,b)=>b.matchAccuracy-a.matchAccuracy);
  if (validMatches.length > 1 && validMatches[0].matchAccuracy-validMatches[1].matchAccuracy < skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin) {
    return {valid:false,reason:'Drawing is ambiguous. Please try again.'};
  }
  return bestMatch || bestFailure || {valid:false,reason:'No ready skill matches this pattern.'};
}

/** Choose a cancellation target locally; empty/unrelated ink never selects a default slot. */
export function closestDrawingSkill(strokes, skills) {
  if (!drawingBounds(strokes)) return null;
  if(recognizeStrictRulesPattern(strokes).valid)return skills.find(w=>w.id==='student-handbook'&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  if(linkedFrameEvidence(strokes))return skills.find(w=>['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(w.id)&&!(w.skillCooldownRemaining>0))||null;
  let best = null, score = .25, runnerUp = 0;
  for (const weapon of skills) {
    if (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining > 0) continue;
    const reference = weapon.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate'?decagrammatonReferenceStrokes():['princess-key','decagrammaton'].includes(weapon.id)?princessKeyReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'water-dousing'?splashReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'student-handbook'?strictRulesReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'throwing-cards'?skilledThrowReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'molotov-cocktail'?molotovReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'luminous-nova'?luminousNovaReferenceStrokes():weapon.id === 'aris-laser' ? supernovaReferenceStrokes() : undefined;
    if (!reference && weapon.id !== 'plana-umbrella') continue;
    const accuracy = drawingAccuracy(strokes, reference);
    if (accuracy > score) { runnerUp = score === .25 ? 0 : score; score = accuracy; best = weapon; }
    else runnerUp = Math.max(runnerUp,accuracy);
  }
  return score-runnerUp >= skillCastSettings.matchMinimumMargin ? best : null;

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');
  if(superWeapon&&!character.ultimateSkill)character.ultimateSkill={id:'decagrammaton-ultimate',name:'Activate Protocol SUPERNOVA',icon:superWeapon.icon,exSkill:true,successCooldown:300};
  if(!superWeapon&&character.ultimateSkill?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate')delete character.ultimateSkill;
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));

import { orbitalCompassSettings, orbitalCompassLevelStats, attackTimeFormula, weaponSizeMultiplier } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale, startingWeaponProjectileCount } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, getEnemy, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { createEnemySpatialIndex } from './enemy-spatial-index.js';
import { drawArtilleryExplosion, artilleryExplosionDuration, artilleryExplosionReady } from './artillery-explosion.js';

/** Nearby-target launch, timed return, or one explosion when its accepted hit budget ends. */
export function createOrbitalCompassAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 const s=orbitalCompassSettings;let owner=null,enabled=true,cooldown=0,time=0,needles=[],explosions=[],shots=0,bursts=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;needles=[];explosions=[];shots=0;bursts=0;}
 function fire(player,weapon,aim,single=false){
  const stats=orbitalCompassLevelStats(weapon.level),body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),area=stats.size*weaponSizeMultiplier(player),count=single?1:startingWeaponProjectileCount(player,'orbital-compass',stats.count);
  const targets=getAllEnemies().map(enemy=>({enemy,body:getEnemyHurtbox(enemy)})).filter(t=>t.enemy.hp>0&&Math.hypot(t.body.x-body.x,t.body.y-body.y)<=s.acquireRange).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.body.x-body.x,a.body.y-body.y)-Math.hypot(b.body.x-body.x,b.body.y-body.y));
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const target=targets[i%targets.length]?.body;let angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x):aim+i*Math.PI*2/count;
   if(target&&targets.length<count)angle+=(i-(count-1)/2)*.12;
   needles.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,angle,rotation:angle,age:0,returnLocked:false,area,count,hitsLeft:stats.hitLimit,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,hits:new Map()});shots++;
  }
 }
 function cast(player,aim=0){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='orbital-compass');if(!weapon)return false;
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
  fire(player,weapon,aim,true);const b=needles[needles.length-1];b.exSkill=true;b.area*=2;b.returning=true;b.hitsLeft=Infinity;return true;
 }
 function steerEx(b,player,dt){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
  if(b.returning&&Math.hypot(body.x-b.x,body.y-b.y)<=Math.max(body.rx,body.ry)+s.speed*dt){
   b.returning=false;b.targetId=null;
  }
  let target=!b.returning&&getEnemy(b.targetId);
  if(!b.returning&&!target){
   let nearest=Infinity;for(const enemy of getAllEnemies()){if(!(enemy.hp>0))continue;const t=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),distance=Math.hypot(t.x-b.x,t.y-b.y);if(distance<nearest){nearest=distance;target=enemy;}}
   b.targetId=target?.id;if(!target)b.returning=true;
  }
  const destination=b.returning?body:getEnemyHurtbox(target);
  b.angle=Math.atan2(destination.y-b.y,destination.x-b.x);
 }
 function roll(player,b,target,explosion=false){
  const base=totalWeaponDamage(player,'orbital-compass',s.damage,b.damageBonuses,{projectileCount:b.count,hitCooldownFrames:(explosion?s.explosionHitCooldown:s.hitCooldown)*60});
  return rollAttackDamage(player,base*(explosion?s.explosionDamage/s.damage:1),random,{target,weaponId:'orbital-compass',skillAttack:Boolean(b.exSkill)});
 }
 function explode(player,b){
  const effect={x:b.x,y:b.y,radius:s.hitRadius*b.area*s.explosionArea,age:0};explosions.push(effect);bursts++;
  // The blast is a single accepted hit per target, not periodic damage from the visual animation.

  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,aim=0){

   }
  }
 }

/** Divide player level by (2 + report tier), add 3, then round halves upward. */
export function standardMobExp(player, tier = 0) {
  return mobExpFormula(player?.level || 1, tier);
}

/** Drop a full-circle boss burst, five elite reports, or one ordinary report. */
export function dropEnemyExp(enemy, random = Math.random) {
  const reports = [];
  if (['yuuka','sensei'].includes(enemy.type)) return reports;
  const boss = enemy.boss === true || (enemy.boss !== false && ['iroha', 'shiroko'].includes(enemy.type));
  // Roll artwork first so its tier bonus does not depend on the resulting EXP.
  const standardMob = (enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard) && !boss && !enemy.elite && enemy.expReward == null;
  const mobTier = standardMob ? (random() < reportSettings.commonChance ? 0 : 1) : undefined;
  const values = boss ? rollBossReports(getActivePlayer(), random, enemy.expReward) : (enemy.elite && !enemy.miniBoss) || enemy.type === 'yuuka' ? rollEliteReports(random, enemy.expReward)
    : [Math.floor(enemy.expReward ?? ((enemy.type === 'mob' || enemy.standard)
      ? standardMobExp(getActivePlayer(), mobTier) : rollEnemyExp(random)))];
  const burstAngle = boss ? random() * Math.PI * 2 : 0;
  for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
    const drop = dropExpReport(enemy, random, value, mobTier);
    if (!drop) continue;
    if (boss) {
      // One report per angular sector guarantees coverage in every direction.
      const angle = burstAngle + (index + random() * 0.5) / values.length * Math.PI * 2;
      const distance = bossExpRewards.minDistance + random() *
        (bossExpRewards.maxDistance - bossExpRewards.minDistance);
      drop.scatter.dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
      drop.scatter.dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
      constrainDropLanding(drop);
    }
    reports.push(drop);
  }
  return reports;
}
